headline: Pakistani Rupee Edges Up Against US Dollar in Inter-Bank Market
summary: The Pakistani rupee gained slightly against the US dollar, appreciating 0.01% in the inter-bank market to close at 276.42.
why: Currency exchange rates reflect foreign exchange liquidity and balance of payments dynamics for emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Pakistani rupee
impacts.why: Inter-bank trading directly determines the daily valuation of the national currency against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
